title: Halifax Waterfront Tour with Ferry Ride
includes: Take a relaxing ferry ride to Dartmouth (Included in Price)
Visit important landmarks and historic sites
Explore Halifax’s scenic waterfront with a local guide
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the rich history and vibrant culture of Halifax on this immersive harborfront walking tour. Led by a local guide, you’ll explore iconic landmarks, hear powerful stories of immigration, and learn about the city’s connection to the Titanic and the Halifax Explosion.
Stroll along the scenic waterfront, visit historic sites, and enjoy a delicious chocolate tasting at Peace by Chocolate. Your experience concludes with a relaxing ferry ride across the harbor to Dartmouth, offering unforgettable views of the Halifax skyline.
Perfect for travelers looking to combine history, culture, and local flavors in one engaging experience.
